title: 第十一章 愤怒的芽衣第十二章 小明
content_zh:
清晨，林萧顶着一对熊猫眼打着哈欠来到神奇宝贝中心，需要购买的物资昨天就已经搞定，今天只需要和芽衣回合就出发了。
让人惊讶的是芽衣比林萧还要来的早，因为在女孩子的观念中，睡眠好皮肤才好，早起什么的最讨厌了。
林萧露出微笑朝芽衣打招呼，“芽衣早啊。”
“噗嗤”芽衣看着林萧的熊猫眼忍不住笑出声来，“你昨晚该不会是没有睡觉吧？”
额。。。。。林萧尴尬的一推四五六，“昨晚因为照顾卡咪龟所以睡得晚了点，放心吧不会耽误今天的行程。”这话要是让卡咪龟听到的话恐怕会掐死他，明明是你昨晚晚上发，春，满床打滚，怎么都推我身上来了？
林萧的扯谎芽衣并没有拆穿，微微一笑：“那我们出发吧，不过做饭的事情可就交给你咯，人家是女孩子，不会做饭呢。”
“我去！”林萧差点一个跟头栽倒在地，尼玛的‘人家可是女孩子，不会做饭呢。’杀伤力真不是一般的大。
这年代的男人伤不起啊，做饭还成了男人的专利了。
对于昨天的事，两人很默契的闭口不提，有些事提出来只会越抹越黑。
一路上芽衣像只开心得像只小兔，四处乱串，活泼可爱的蹦蹦跳跳，不停的给林萧讲诉自己家乡的美景。
不得不说两个人旅行的确比一个人闷着头赶路好多的，没过多久芽衣就躺在草地上摆起大字开始耍小脾气了，“不行了，不行了。腿酸死了，林萧我们休息一会吧，就一会好不好？”
说完还用一双蓝色的大眼睛，楚楚可怜的望着林萧，生怕林萧不答应。
林萧自然不会再这种事上斤斤计较，朝芽衣打了个ok的手势说道：“那就休息一会吧，正好我要给小精灵做训练，我们午饭也在这里解决好了。”
把小精灵都放出来，林萧给卡咪龟布置训练的任务，至于快龙和班吉拉随它们去了，实力到了它们这基层已经很难提升了。
“卡咪龟，今天你就练习水泡和钢铁尾巴好了，等熟练以后可以找快龙对练，知道吗？”
卡咪龟点点头，屁颠屁颠的跑到一旁练习绝招去了。现在林萧只是布置训练任务，卡咪龟就会很自觉的去完成，不仅这样，只要有空卡咪龟都会和快龙一起对练，当然快龙只是陪练，班吉拉的话就别想了，一个拳头都有半个卡咪龟大了，恐怕不用任何技能一拳就能把卡咪龟打趴下。
况且卡咪龟也不笨，知道班吉拉不论是战斗还是练习从来都是全力出击，所以它的练习对象一直是快龙，而且快龙脾气很好，比班吉拉好相处。
班吉拉找了一块大岩石靠上，舒服的闭上双眼，享受日光浴。快龙飞上天空四处翱翔，遇上野生的小精灵还能帮林萧赚点金币，林萧的小精灵只有快龙会这样做，卡咪龟只对比自己强的小精灵感兴趣，野生的小精灵除非林萧让它战斗，否则就算有小精灵跑到它面前，它也是该干嘛就干嘛，在它的字典里好像没有主动出击这词。
安排好小精灵，林萧取出各种食材准备做饭。
“林萧，班吉拉怎么会这么强壮？而且你是怎么收服它的？”芽衣看着不远处晒太阳的班吉拉，悄声问道。

林萧对芽衣眨眨眼睛，臭屁道：“当然是自动投奔我的啊，唉~谁让哥我人品太好，人品好了自然一切都好。”
“呕！！”芽衣做了个呕吐的表情，鄙视道：“就你那啦啦踏踏的样子还人品好呢，那这样说来本小姐岂不是幸运女神了？”
“呵呵”林萧突然蹲下拉住芽衣柔软的小手一脸正经恳求道：“女神啊，求你赐百八十个美女给我吧，我一定会为你多烧香，烧纸的的。”
被林萧拉住自己的小手，芽衣吓了一跳，可听到林萧说的话后立刻就暴走了。
“林萧，你个混蛋！百八十个美女？你以为美女都是你家养的吗？你这个恶心的自恋狂！烧香、烧纸？你不是在咒我死吗？”
芽衣愤怒的捏着小拳头，恶狠狠的朝林萧扑了过来。
“女神饶命啊，没有百八十个，三五个我还是能接受的。干嘛啊你！别打我的脸，这可是我泡妞的资本，你不能破坏。”
“喂喂喂！你属狗的吗，怎么能咬人，快松开。”
“不要，就不松开，我咬死你个坏蛋。”
“看你以后还胡说八道，我咬死你！”
嬉闹一阵两人才鸣金收兵，战胜的芽衣得意洋洋的昂起小脑袋，战败的林萧苦着一张脸，揉着脸上的两排牙印开始做饭。
揉着被咬得发紫的脸，林萧郁闷的道：“哎，还好今天早上没有洗脸，对了，藐视昨天卡咪龟还在我脸上舔得满脸口水。。。。。”小样和我斗？你还太年轻了。
原本得意的芽衣听到林萧的抱怨，小脸瞬间黑了下来，“没洗脸？脸上还有卡咪龟的口水？呕！”
想到这里芽衣胃里一阵翻滚，捂住嘴跑到一旁干呕去了。
过了半响，芽衣发出一声尖叫，张牙舞爪的冲过来，“混蛋林萧，我要杀了你！！！！呕！！你给我站住！！！”

content_en:
In the early morning, Lin Xiao came to the Pokémon Center with a pair of panda eyes and yawned. The supplies that needed to be purchased were already purchased yesterday. Today, he only had to go to the round with Mei to set off.
What's surprising is that Mei Yi came earlier than Lin Xiao, because in the concept of girls, good skin is good when you sleep well, and getting up early is the most annoying thing.
Lin Xiao smiled and greeted Mei Yi, "Good morning, Mei Yi."
"Pfft." Yayi looked at Lin Xiao's panda eyes and couldn't help laughing, "Did you not sleep last night?"
Um. . . . . Lin Xiao pushed 456 awkwardly, "I slept a little late last night because I was taking care of Cammy Turtle. Don't worry, it won't delay today's schedule." If Cammy Turtle hears this, I'm afraid he will strangle him to death. It was obviously you who made it last night, Chun, rolling all over the bed, why did you push me?
Lin Xiao's lie was not exposed by Yayi, and he smiled slightly: "Then let's set off, but I'll leave the cooking to you. I'm a girl and I don't know how to cook."
"I'll go!" Lin Xiao almost fell to the ground, "I'm a girl, I don't know how to cook." ’ The lethality is really extraordinary.
Men in this era can't afford to get hurt. Cooking has become a man's exclusive privilege.
Regarding what happened yesterday, the two of them had a tacit understanding not to mention anything. Bringing up some things would only make them darker.
Along the way, Yayi was as happy as a bunny, wandering around, jumping lively and cutely, and kept telling Lin Xiao about the beautiful scenery of her hometown.
I have to say that traveling with two people is indeed much better than rushing alone. It didn’t take long for Meiyi to lie down on the grass, put up big characters and start to show off her temper, "I can’t do it anymore, I can’t do it anymore. My legs are so sore, Lin Xiao, let’s take a rest, just for a while, okay?"
After saying that, he looked at Lin Xiao pitifully with a pair of big blue eyes, for fear that Lin Xiao would not agree.
Naturally, Lin Xiao would not care about this kind of thing anymore. He made an OK gesture to Mei Yi and said, "Then let's take a rest. I just have to train the elf, and we will have lunch here."
After releasing all the elves, Lin Xiao assigned training tasks to Cammy Turtle. As for Kuailong and Bangila, they just left it alone. It was already difficult to improve their strength at their grassroots level.
"Kami Turtle, today you just need to practice blisters and steel tail. Once you're proficient, you can spar with Kuailong, you know?"
Cammy Turtle nodded and ran to the side to practice his special moves. Now Lin Xiao is just assigning training tasks, and Cammy Turtle will consciously complete them. Not only that, Cammy Turtle will spar with Kuailong whenever he has time. Of course, Kuailong is just a sparring partner. Don't even think about Bangila. A fist is half the size of Cammy Turtle. I'm afraid he can knock Cammy Turtle down with one punch without using any skills.
Besides, Cammy Turtle is not stupid either. He knows that Bangila always attacks with all his strength whether in battle or training, so his training target is always Kuailong, and Kuailong has a good temper and is easier to get along with than Bangila.
Banjila found a big rock to lean on, closed her eyes comfortably, and enjoyed the sunbathing. Kuailong flies up into the sky and flies around. When meeting wild elves, it can help Lin Xiao earn some gold coins. Only Kuailong can do this among Lin Xiao's elves. Cammy Turtle is only interested in elves that are stronger than itself. Unless Lin Xiao lets it fight, a wild elf will just do whatever it wants even if an elf runs in front of it. There seems to be no word to take the initiative in its dictionary.
After arranging the elf, Lin Xiao took out various ingredients and prepared to cook.
"Lin Xiao, how can Bangila be so strong? And how did you tame it?" Yayi looked at Bangila basking in the sun not far away and asked quietly.
Lin Xiao blinked at Ya Yi and said, "Of course you defected to me automatically. Alas~ My character is too good. If my character is good, everything will be fine."
"Ouch!!" Mei saidHe made a vomiting expression and said disdainfully: "You are still a good person with your lala-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-ta-da look, so wouldn't this make me the goddess of luck?"
"Haha" Lin Xiao suddenly squatted down and took Mei Yi's soft little hand and begged with a serious face: "Goddess, please give me one hundred and eighty beauties. I will definitely burn more incense and paper for you."
When Lin Xiao held her little hand, Mei Yi was startled, but after hearing what Lin Xiao said, she immediately ran away.
"Lin Xiao, you bastard! One hundred and eighty beauties? Do you think all the beauties are raised by your family? You disgusting narcissist! Burning incense and paper? Aren't you cursing me to death?"
Yayi clenched her fists angrily and rushed towards Lin Xiao fiercely.
"Goddess, please forgive me, there are not a hundred and eighty, I can still accept three or five. What are you doing? Don't hit me in the face, this is my capital to pick up girls, you can't destroy it."
"Hey, hey, hey! Are you a dog? How can you bite someone? Let go."
"No, if you don't let go, I'll bite you to death, you bad guy."
"If you continue to talk nonsense in the future, I will bite you to death!"
After playing for a while, the two of them retreated. The defeated Meiyi raised her head proudly, while the defeated Lin Xiao had a sad face, rubbed the two rows of teeth marks on his face and started cooking.
Rubbing his bitten purple face, Lin Xiao said depressedly: "Hey, it's a good thing I didn't wash my face this morning. By the way, I despise the fact that Cammy Turtle licked my face yesterday and drooled all over it..." Are you trying to fight with me? You are too young.
When Mei Yi, who was originally proud, heard Lin Xiao's complaint, her face darkened instantly, "You didn't wash your face? There is still Cammy Turtle's saliva on your face? Ugh!"
Thinking of this, Mei Yi's stomach tumbled, she covered her mouth and ran to the side to retch.
After a while, Yayi let out a scream and rushed over with bared teeth and claws, "Bastard Lin Xiao, I'm going to kill you!!!! Ugh! Stop!!!"
